text:
Eve: Quick preflight — PR #2718 (adds feature X + migration) is green locally but CI queue is ≈45m and there's a DB schema lock until Sun 02:00 UTC. Options: wait for the window, split the migration into its own PR, or try to land code via canary. Need decision/eyes @frank @maya 
Frank: I can review the code now, but I don't want to approve the migration in the same PR. Can we split? Is the migration self-contained? 
Maya: It touches two tables and a trigger. @sam owns migrations — Sam, can you advise if splitting is safe and whether you can land the migration in the maintenance window? 
Sam: I can take the migration PR and land it during the maintenance window. If we split, we should be able to merge the code part earlier. I'll add the db-migration-approve label when it's ready. 
Leo: CI note — canary lane has capacity in ~2h, general lane backlog ~45m (might change). We can also request a priority run with `ci:priority` but that sometimes gets throttled. 
DevBot: [queue-status] Canary lane available in ~2h, General queue wait ~45m. 
Eve: OK — plan proposal: split migration out now, Sam opens migration PR, code PR becomes code-only and we request a canary run. If canary passes, we merge code today; Sam will land migration in the Sunday 02:00 UTC window. Agree? 
Frank: Sounds good. I'll start the review on the split code PR and post any nits. 
Maya: I'm fine with that. I'll add `ci:priority` to the code PR once it's split to attempt a faster canary run. Also can we avoid a rebase if Sam lands migration first? 
Sam: I'll open migration PR in ~30m and ping DB-ops. If migration lands first, rebase shouldn't be necessary — but if not, I'll coordinate a rebase window. 
DevBot: PR #2719 created by Sam — db-migration (link: https://git.example/r/2719). 
Frank: Minor inline comments on the code PR, nothing blocking. Will approve after fixes. 
Eve: Great — split-and-canary it is. I'll monitor CI queue and ping infra if the backlog spikes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: 
Leo: I'll request the canary run and update the ticket with run id. 
Maya: Thanks — will follow up on approvals. 
Sam: Migration PR opened and labeled `db-migration-approve`. Will be on-call during the maintenance window. 
Eve: Closing the loop here — action items: Sam opens/lands migration in window; Frank approves post-fix; Maya requests canary; Leo requests run and watches queue. I'll keep this thread updated with CI times.
